summary.detail: Any field at the host universities. NUST MISIS says its English-taught master's programmes do not require Russian. Duration not stated.
Postgraduate studies ('PhD equivalents'). Residency and postgraduate applicants must also submit a motivation letter and a research summary or article.

notes: Programmes not enumerated: the quota is open to all disciplines at many universities. The only official page read that gives levels is the host university NUST MISIS page; it mentions '120+ study programs' for MISIS only (fields named: Materials Science, IT, Economics, Linguistics).

The federal portal education-in-russia.com is a JavaScript app and returned no readable text via fetch; the Rossotrudnichestvo/Russian House Dhaka page returned only a browser-check page. So the federal programme search page could not be confirmed: catalogue_url is null and status is partly.

Non-official sources and the earlier pass mention specialist programmes and residency as extra levels under the quota; these are not recorded as codes. MISIS lists only bachelor, master and postgraduate.
Latest published call on the host page is 2027/28 (deadlines 15 Dec 2026 for CIS, 15 Jan 2027 for others).

summary.detail: Up to 30 grants of 11 months (1 Sep 2026 to 31 Jul 2027, not renewable) for official, in-person university master's degrees in Spain of at most 60 ECTS credits. No field restriction in the call; the applicant must show admission to the master's applied for. Spanish knowledge required (except Equatorial Guinea); if the master is taught in another language, knowledge of that language is also required. Open only to permanent public employees of the listed African and Middle Eastern countries.
summary.source_text: másteres universitarios (oficiales) de carácter presencial en España de 60 créditos ECTS como máximo

notes: Full call text read via the BDNS API (convocatoria 916186, document 'CV 26-27 AFRICA-MED MASTER.pdf', signed 29 June 2026); it names no specific master's programmes or universities, so none are listed. The BOE extract (BOE-B-2026-22411) and Spanish Embassy notices agree.
Official sources are Spanish only; quotes are in Spanish. The 2026-27 call is closed.

summary.detail: Merit-based scholarship for top international applicants recommended for admission, stated in the Tuition fees section of the NU master's regular admissions page. The NU international admissions page says the scholarship covers the tuition fee, medical insurance and a monthly stipend, and that candidates are recommended by the admissions committee of each school. NU FAQ: all master's and PhD programmes are taught in English except the Executive MBA (English with simultaneous interpretation into Russian).
summary.source_text: There are merit-based "Abay Kunanbayev" scholarships for top international applicants recommended for admission.

summary.detail: Same sentence appears in the Tuition fees section of the NU doctoral (PhD) regular admissions page. Programmes are taught in English. The same page lists doctoral tuition of USD 23,500 for 2025/2026 (except Doctor of Public Management).
summary.source_text: There are merit-based "Abay Kunanbayev" scholarships for top international applicants recommended for admission.

notes: Bachelor/Foundation is NOT supported: the NU foundation-undergraduate regular admissions page and its Financial Aid & Scholarships page do not mention the Abay Kunanbayev scholarship. The general international admissions page (heading 'Abai Scholarship') says 'top international candidates' without naming a level. A web-search summary claiming undergraduate wording could not be matched to any official page text.

Programmes are not enumerated: the pages do not tie the scholarship to named programmes; it is awarded on recommendation of each school's admissions committee. Master's schools on the NU page: SCAI, SSH, School of Medicine, SOE, GSB, GSPP, GSE; the PhD page lists the same schools. NU's 'All programs (A-Z)' page is linked from its admissions pages but its address was not fetched, so catalogue_url is null.
Contact for scholarship details given on the international page: international.admissions@nu.edu.kz.

summary.detail: 10 grants; 100% tuition; held for 4 academic years (not extended) while meeting GPA and credit conditions. The grant entry names no specific programme (other grants on the same page name the BISB, BSCS, BLLB and BIL programmes).
